items.title: ADP: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: ADP raised its full-year fiscal 2027 revenue outlook to 6% growth, driven by AI deployment across service teams, embedded banking partnerships with institutions like PNC Bank, and expansion of its Lyric HCM platform into four European countries. These strategic initiatives are strengthening operational efficiency, lowering customer acquisition costs, and building competitive moats through cross-border compliance capabilities.

items.title: C vs PNC: Which Stock Offers the Better Investment Opportunity?
items.summary: Citigroup and PNC Financial are compared as investment opportunities in the U.S. banking sector. Citigroup is streamlining operations through international divestitures and cost-cutting, projecting 4-5% revenue growth and $2-2.5B in annualized savings by 2026. PNC Financial is expanding through acquisitions and branch growth, with expected NII growth of 15-15.5% in 2026. Citigroup is rated as the better investment choice due to stronger earnings growth outlook, cheaper valuation, and upward estimate revisions, earning a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) versus PNC's Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: KeyCorp Raises 2026 Revenue Outlook: What's Driving It?
items.summary: KeyCorp raised its 2026 revenue guidance to 8% growth from 7-8%, driven by strong loan growth (4-5%), NII expansion (9-11%), and improved fee income guidance (6-7% adjusted). The Clearwater acquisition and robust investment banking activity support the outlook. NIM is expected to reach 3.00-3.05% by year-end. Peer banks PNC and Citizens Financial also project solid 2026 growth.
